label: feeding_start
note: tool_pose is the CONFIGURED TOOL frame, not the flange: the arm carries a 120 mm z-offset for the 2F-85. The fork adds more. Measured camera-to-tine-tip is ~105 mm, so the reported point lands within a few cm of the real tip -- good enough to report and to stand off by, NOT good enough for the 4 mm flesh/bowl window, which is terminated on torque instead.  J1 and J3 are held at their INTENDED exact values (-90.000 and 0.000), not the measured -89.998/-0.003: those two were commanded to be exact and the residual is servo steady-state error, so baking a measurement back in would let it drift a little further every time the pose is re-captured.
